source_clause: C16.) EXTERIOR REAR-VIEW MIRROR DEFROST has on/ off state. EXTERIOR REAR-VIEW MIRROR DEFROST is independent of any other climate functions.
reasoning: 驗證目標：2.15（C16.）定出對外後視鏡除霜之 on/off 狀態與其獨立性，兩個 037 leaf 對應之，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：本節之條文**無任何配置限定語**，故不補配置式 PC（與 `2.4`／`2.5` 同例）—— **惟 `2.9`（C8）以「if this feature available」暗示其為可選配備**，該不對稱已於上繳 36 §5.4 呈報；依 **R-C34** 第九軸與第十三軸暴露 → 全數補，EMEA 排除補並逐條答。為什麼這樣切：`021-02`（獨立性）之驗證需兩個不同干擾源（AUTO、climate off），因「獨立」之否證只需一個反例。刻意略過：**本節之條款標籤為 `C16.`，與 `16.17` 之 `C16.` 撞號**（A-CF13 第一項），故 traceability 一律以 outline 節次為鍵（profile §1），`specification_reference` 記 2.15 而非條款標籤；C16 未述該功能之操作元件位置，故步驟以功能名稱為目標而不指定按鈕位置（§8.4.1）。

distinguishing_axis.axis: profile §3.2 第九軸「EMEA ICS 車型」之值（介面型，R-C34）
distinguishing_axis.delta: `2.15` 取**非 ICS** 值，`16.15` 取 **ICS** 值。**兩節之 TC 三欄逐字相同**（`021-01`≡`121-01`、`021-02`≡`121-02`），差異僅在 `pre_conditions` 之軸值，故 `duplicate_of` 不填而以軸值區辨。**本對是全corpus 中唯一兩側 leaf 數相等且逐條等價者**，故其「兩份 TC 是否應合併為一份並以軸值參數化」之問題最為赤裸 —— 已隨 037 分解案登 DR #38

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: 對外後視鏡除霜之 on/off 狀態
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section（6.3 使其移除）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（3 旋鈕 ICS 車無 HVAC 畫面／popup，出處 2.14）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: 補排除；**逐條答見各 TC 之 `emea_ics_review`**（R-C36-1）—— 本批 14 條中 **9 條為 `no`**，其分界見 `ch16_mirror_map.tsv`

tcs.tc_title: Exterior mirror defrost has an on and off state
tcs.test_item: EXTERIOR REAR-VIEW MIRROR DEFROST shall have an on/off state
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The climate screen is open and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the exterior rear-view mirror defrost on
2. Turn the exterior rear-view mirror defrost off
tcs.expected_result:
1. The exterior rear-view mirror defrost is on
2. The exterior rear-view mirror defrost is off
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ICE14「EXTERIOR REAR-VIEW MIRROR DEFROST has on/ off state」逐字相同（鏡射表記 16.15 ↔ 2.15 mirrored）

tcs.tc_title: Exterior mirror defrost is independent of the other climate functions
tcs.test_item: EXTERIOR REAR-VIEW MIRROR DEFROST shall be independent of any other climate functions
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The climate screen is open and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the exterior rear-view mirror defrost on
2. Turn AUTO on and read the exterior rear-view mirror defrost state
3. Turn the climate system off and read the exterior rear-view mirror defrost state
tcs.expected_result:
1. The exterior rear-view mirror defrost is on
2. The exterior rear-view mirror defrost is still on
3. The exterior rear-view mirror defrost is still on
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: **ICE14 僅一句**（on/off 狀態），**不含 C16 之「is independent of any other climate functions」** —— 本條所驗者於 ch16 無對應句
